picks.headline: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Super 34B Open Reasoning Vision Model
picks.why: NVIDIA's new 34B open model unifies trajectory generation, reasoning traces, and synthetic data labeling for autonomous systems.
picks.title: Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super

picks.headline: GitHub Retires GitHub Models API and Playground Service
picks.why: Developers relying on GitHub's unified LLM playground and API endpoints must migrate to alternative provider platforms.
picks.title: GitHub Models is now retired

picks.headline: Anthropic System Prompt Reveals Temporary US Export Controls on New Models
picks.why: System prompt updates for Claude Opus 5 signal active regulatory export restriction enforcement on unreleased frontier models.
picks.title: Quoting Claude Opus 5 system prompt

picks.headline: SynChain Exploit Forces Agentic Systems to Autonomously Build Attack Chains
picks.why: Demonstrates a novel threat model where computer-use agents self-synthesize malicious payloads directly into their long-term memory and skill repositories.
picks.title: SynChain: Inducing Computer-Use Agent Systems to Construct Their Own Attack Chains

picks.headline: D-SCAN Detects RAG Poisoning Attacks via Document Attention Collapse
picks.why: Moves beyond brittle output-side uncertainty metrics by measuring internal document-level attention collapse to identify poisoned context.
picks.title: When Context Bites: Detecting RAG Poisoning via Document-Level Attention Collapse

picks.headline: Mechanistic Safety Exploits Reveal Vulnerabilities in Diffusion LLMs
picks.why: Uncovers that safety alignment in diffusion-based language models is sparse, highly fragile, and easily removed via neuron pruning.
picks.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits

picks.headline: Firebird Launches Major CIS Region AI Factory Targeting 70k GPUs
picks.why: Expands regional AI compute infrastructure in Eurasia with plans to deploy over 70,000 NVIDIA Blackwell and Rubin GPUs.
picks.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia

papers.headline: Theoretical Analysis Proves RL Avoids Multi-Task SFT Gradient Conflicts
papers.why: Explains why multi-task supervised fine-tuning suffers from task conflict while reinforcement learning enables stable task coexistence through sparse parameter updates.
papers.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs

papers.headline: Muon Optimizer Triggers Post-Grokking Instability in Transformers
papers.why: Identifies a key failure mode in Muon-trained models where rapid parameter updates cause generalization collapse at the readout interface after grokking.
papers.title: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers

papers.headline: Modular Test-Time Training Framework Formalizes Test-Time Compute DAGs
papers.why: Formalizes test-time training as composable directed acyclic graphs, simplifying component ablation and improving performance up to 1.45B parameters.
papers.title: Modular TTT: Rethinking Test-Time Training as Composable Modules
